# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/mech_cold.mjs, spec docs/specs/04_mechanics/cold_lands.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Scripted effects take no parameters in 1.19.3 (decision E1): a call sets zin_arg_<name> temporary variables first.
# winner: coldor 1, isengard 2 (zin_cold_end_march_war).

# Scope: the country whose lean moves. zin_arg_value: positive toward Fandanar, negative toward Isengard.
zin_cold_add_lean = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zin_cold_lean }
		add_to_variable = { zin_cold_lean = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_cold_lean min = -100 max = 100 }
	}
}

# zin_arg_value on every lean-holding Cold Lands country.
zin_cold_add_lean_all = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_cold_is_clan_realm = yes }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
	}
}

# zin_arg_value on Isengard's defiance; the flag zin_cold_charter_ready marks the swear threshold.
zin_cold_add_defiance = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = MLK }
		MLK = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_cold_isengard_defiance = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_cold_isengard_defiance min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_cold_isengard_defiance < 30.01 } }
				set_global_flag = zin_cold_charter_ready
			}
			else = {
				clr_global_flag = zin_cold_charter_ready
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Accord's reach (section 1): 100 x weight / 150 over the Cold Lands states Coldor does not own, Mp'E excluded.
zin_cold_update_reach = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_weight = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_cold_lands = yes
			NOT = { is_owned_by = CLD }
			NOT = { zin_is_site_yeldenne = yes }
			controller = {
				OR = {
					original_tag = CLD
					is_subject_of = CLD
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_weight = 1.5 }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_cold_lands = yes
			NOT = { is_owned_by = CLD }
			NOT = { zin_is_site_yeldenne = yes }
			controller = {
				is_in_faction_with = CLD
				NOT = { original_tag = CLD }
				NOT = { is_subject_of = CLD }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_weight = 1 }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_cold_weight = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_cold_weight = 150 }
	CLD = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_accord_reach = zin_cold_weight }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_cold_accord_reach min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_reach_pp = zin_cold_accord_reach }
		divide_variable = { zin_cold_reach_pp = 400 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_reach_winter = zin_cold_accord_reach }
		divide_variable = { zin_cold_reach_winter = -500 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# The March Forts (section 1): a border war between a Coldor and an Isengard march state; the attacker is always the Coldor side.
zin_cold_start_march_war = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_cold_march_war_allowed = yes }
		CLD = {
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = {
					zin_is_site_isengard_march = yes
					any_neighbor_state = {
						is_owned_by = MLK
						zin_is_site_isengard_march = yes
					}
				}
				save_event_target_as = zin_cold_march_attacker
				random_neighbor_state = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = MLK
						zin_is_site_isengard_march = yes
					}
					save_event_target_as = zin_cold_march_defender
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = zin_cold_march_attacker
				has_event_target = zin_cold_march_defender
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_cold_march_war_active
			start_border_war = {
				change_state_after_war = no
				combat_width = 80
				minimum_duration_in_days = 45
				attacker = {
					state = event_target:zin_cold_march_attacker
					num_provinces = 4
					on_win = zin_cold.34
					on_lose = zin_cold.35
					on_cancel = zin_cold.36
				}
				defender = {
					state = event_target:zin_cold_march_defender
					num_provinces = 4
					on_win = zin_cold.35
					on_lose = zin_cold.34
					on_cancel = zin_cold.36
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# zin_arg_winner: 1 Coldor, 2 Isengard. Both sides fire their result event; the flag makes the second call a no-op.
zin_cold_end_march_war = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_march_war_active }
		clr_global_flag = zin_cold_march_war_active
		set_variable = { global.zin_cold_march_winner = zin_arg_winner }
		CLD = { set_country_flag = zin_cold_march_war_fought }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_winner = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -25 }
			zin_cold_add_defiance = yes
			CLD = { add_war_support = 0.05 }
			MLK = { add_stability = -0.05 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
			zin_cold_add_defiance = yes
			MLK = { add_war_support = 0.05 }
			CLD = { add_stability = -0.05 }
		}
		news_event = { id = zin_cold.32 }
	}
}

# Isengard swears to the Northern Accord (section 1): a league, not a crown; it keeps its warlord and its forts.
zin_cold_isengard_swears = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = MLK
			country_exists = CLD
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_isengard_sworn }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_cold_isengard_sworn
		MLK = {
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = CLD modifier = zin_opinion_cold_rivalry }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = CLD modifier = zin_cold_accord_kin }
			add_ideas = zin_cold_sworn_to_the_accord
		}
		CLD = {
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = MLK modifier = zin_opinion_cold_rivalry }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = MLK modifier = zin_cold_accord_kin }
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_faction_leader = yes
					MLK = { is_in_faction = no }
				}
				add_to_faction = MLK
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope Coldor. zin_arg_value levels on the yeti pact; reaching level 1 makes the non-aggression pact and lean +10 (section 4).
zin_cold_add_yeti_pact = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_prev = zin_cold_yeti_pact }
	add_to_variable = { zin_cold_yeti_pact = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_cold_yeti_pact min = 0 max = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_cold_prev < 0.99 }
			check_variable = { zin_cold_yeti_pact > 0.99 }
			country_exists = YEI
		}
		diplomatic_relation = { country = YEI relation = non_aggression_pact active = yes }
		YEI = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_cold_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope Coldor. zin_arg_value levels on the giant pact; reaching level 1 makes the non-aggression pact and lean +10 (section 4).
zin_cold_add_giant_pact = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_prev = zin_cold_giant_pact }
	add_to_variable = { zin_cold_giant_pact = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_cold_giant_pact min = 0 max = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_cold_prev < 0.99 }
			check_variable = { zin_cold_giant_pact > 0.99 }
			country_exists = NIV
		}
		diplomatic_relation = { country = NIV relation = non_aggression_pact active = yes }
		NIV = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_cold_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a Cold Lands country. The values of zin_cold_winter_mod for this winter; winter stores halve them (section 3).
zin_cold_set_winter_values = {
	set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_attr = 0 }
	set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_stab = 0 }
	set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_pop = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter < 1.99 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_attr = 0.1 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_stab = -0.02 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_pop = -0.05 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter > 1.99 } }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_attr = 0.25 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_stab = -0.05 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_winter_pop = -0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_cold_winter_stores }
		multiply_variable = { zin_cold_winter_attr = 0.5 }
		multiply_variable = { zin_cold_winter_stab = 0.5 }
		multiply_variable = { zin_cold_winter_pop = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cold_winter_mod } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cold_winter_mod }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Sets zin_cold_winter (0 mild, 1 hard, 2 bitter; the fixed list under the historical path) and opens the winter season.
zin_cold_roll_winter = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			check_variable = { global.year < 1759.99 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1748 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1749 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1750 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1751 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1752 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1753 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1754 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1755 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1756 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1757 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1758 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.year = 1759 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			40 = { set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 0 } }
			40 = { set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 1 } }
			20 = { set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 2 } }
		}
	}
	set_global_flag = zin_cold_winter_season
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_cold_is_cold = yes }
		zin_cold_set_winter_values = yes
	}
}

# The Thaw: the season ends and no winter modifier remains.
zin_cold_end_winter = {
	clr_global_flag = zin_cold_winter_season
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_cold_is_cold = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cold_winter_mod } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cold_winter_mod }
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_cold_fed_this_winter
		clr_country_flag = zin_cold_raided_this_winter
	}
}

# zin_arg_target: the steading Coldor feeds.
zin_cold_feed = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CLD }
		var:zin_arg_target = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
			zin_cold_add_lean = yes
			add_stability = 0.03
			set_country_flag = zin_cold_fed_by_fandanar
			set_country_flag = zin_cold_fed_this_winter
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = CLD modifier = zin_cold_fed_us }
		}
	}
}

# zin_arg_target: the steading Isengard feeds.
zin_cold_feed_by_isengard = {
	var:zin_arg_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
		add_stability = 0.03
		set_country_flag = zin_cold_fed_by_isengard
		set_country_flag = zin_cold_fed_this_winter
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = MLK modifier = zin_cold_fed_us }
	}
}

# The Neck Road opens (section 7).
zin_cold_open_neck_road = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_neck_road } }
		set_global_flag = zin_cold_neck_road
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = CLD }
			CLD = { add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_cold_neck_road_trade days = 730 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = GNW }
			GNW = { add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_cold_neck_road_trade days = 730 } }
		}
	}
}

# Scope Coldor: a timber sale to the West (section 7).
zin_cold_sell_timber = {
	add_political_power = 40
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
	zin_west_add_fleet = yes
}

# Scope Coldor: Beyond the Last Steading (section 5).
zin_cold_chart_far_ice = {
	set_country_flag = zin_cold_far_ice_charted
	add_ideas = zin_cold_far_ice_charted_idea
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_cold_is_clan_realm = yes
			any_owned_state = { zin_is_region_far_northwest = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
	}
}

# zin_arg_value toward Fandanar for the owner of the ice host's state (section 5).
zin_cold_reward_ice_host = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_eindil_ice = yes } }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
	}
}

# Scope Coldor: the wardens' option of journey event 11 (regard and renown, no delay).
zin_cold_send_wardens = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
	zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
	zin_eindil_add_renown = yes
}

# Scope any: A Share of the Plunder (section 8); the joining rule reads zin_cold_joins_crossing.
zin_cold_join_crossing = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_joins_crossing }
			has_variable = global.zin_west_convener
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_cold_joins_crossing
		var:global.zin_west_convener = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				add_to_faction = CLD
				if = {
					limit = { has_war_with = AEN }
					CLD = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = PREV enemy = AEN hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope Coldor: the White Companies sail (section 8); the template follows the warfare spec's composition.
zin_cold_sail_white_companies = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_equipment = { zin_arms_equipment > 2999 }
			has_manpower > 29999
		}
		add_manpower = -30000
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = zin_arms_equipment amount = -3000 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_template = "White Company" } }
			division_template = {
				name = "White Company"
				division_names_group = ZIN_HOSTS
				regiments = {
					zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
					zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
					zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
					zin_men_infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
					zin_men_infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
					zin_men_infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
					zin_men_archers = { x = 2 y = 0 }
					zin_men_archers = { x = 2 y = 1 }
					zin_men_cavalry = { x = 2 y = 2 }
				}
				support = {
					zin_support_scouts = { x = 0 y = 0 }
					zin_support_healers = { x = 0 y = 1 }
					zin_support_quartermasters = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		zin_eindil_join_coalition = yes
		create_unit = {
			division = "name = \"White Company\" division_template = \"White Company\" start_experience_factor = 0.3 start_equipment_factor = 1"
			owner = CLD
			count = 3
			allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
			country_score = {
				base = 10
				modifier = {
					add = 500
					is_in_faction_with = CLD
					NOT = { original_tag = CLD }
				}
				modifier = {
					add = 300
					original_tag = AEN
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
		zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
	}
}

# Startup: 1 Mistfall 1748 lies 245 days and 1 Deepwinter 1749 306 days after the start.
zin_cold_schedule_seasons = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_mistfall = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_mistfall = 245 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_moot = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_moot = 306 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.zin_cold_due_mistfall }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_cold_delay min = 1 max = 365 }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.10 days = [DAYS] }
		}
		DAYS = "[?global.zin_cold_delay|0]"
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.zin_cold_due_moot }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_cold_delay min = 1 max = 365 }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.20 days = [DAYS] }
		}
		DAYS = "[?global.zin_cold_delay|0]"
	}
}

# The Thaw falls 120 days after this Mistfall; the next Mistfall a year after this one, counted from the due day.
zin_cold_next_mistfall = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_thaw = global.zin_cold_due_mistfall }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_thaw = 120 }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_mistfall = 365 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.zin_cold_due_mistfall }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_cold_delay min = 1 max = 365 }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.10 days = [DAYS] }
		}
		DAYS = "[?global.zin_cold_delay|0]"
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.zin_cold_due_thaw }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_cold_delay min = 1 max = 365 }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.13 days = [DAYS] }
		}
		DAYS = "[?global.zin_cold_delay|0]"
	}
}

zin_cold_next_moot = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_cold_due_moot = 365 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.zin_cold_due_moot }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_cold_delay = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_cold_delay min = 1 max = 365 }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.20 days = [DAYS] }
		}
		DAYS = "[?global.zin_cold_delay|0]"
	}
}

# The monthly runner (on Coldor, or the anchor): lost seasons, reach, winter values, defiance drift, the Iron Hand charter, the hall guard, and last the Cold Lands tree layouts (E4).
zin_cold_monthly = {
	set_global_flag = { flag = zin_cold_month_ran days = 25 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_cold_due_mistfall }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_t_late = global.zin_cold_due_mistfall }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_t_late = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days > zin_cold_t_late } }
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_cold_due_moot }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_t_late = global.zin_cold_due_moot }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_t_late = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days > zin_cold_t_late } }
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_cold_due_thaw }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_t_late = global.zin_cold_due_thaw }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_t_late = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days > zin_cold_t_late } }
			country_event = { id = zin_cold.13 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CLD }
		CLD = { zin_cold_update_reach = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_winter_season }
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_cold_is_cold = yes }
			zin_cold_set_winter_values = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = MLK }
		MLK = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cold_drift = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = CLD
					CLD = { check_variable = { zin_cold_accord_reach > 39.99 } }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_drift = -0.3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = CLD
					CLD = { any_enemy_country = { zin_cold_is_cold = no } }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_drift = 0.3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = zin_cold_bread_from_fandanar }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cold_drift = -0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_cold_drift }
			zin_cold_add_defiance = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_cold_isengard_defiance > 79.99 } }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						zin_cold_is_clan_realm = yes
						is_neighbor_of = MLK
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
					zin_cold_add_lean = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = zin_cold_charter_ready
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_charter_sent }
				zin_cold_isengard_may_swear = yes
				country_exists = CLD
				CLD = {
					has_country_flag = zin_cold_iron_hand
					has_country_flag = zin_cold_march_war_fought
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_cold_charter_sent
			MLK = { country_event = { id = zin_cold.30 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = CLD
			CLD = {
				has_idea = zin_cold_hall_guard
				NOT = { has_guaranteed = YEL }
			}
		}
		CLD = { remove_ideas = zin_cold_hall_guard }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_cold_is_cold = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

# on_declare_war (ROOT declares, FROM is the target): an outsider attacks Coldor; a level-3 pact calls Hearth and Height.
zin_cold_on_declare_war = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			FROM = { original_tag = CLD }
			zin_cold_is_cold = no
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_cold_invader = ROOT }
		CLD = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_cold_yeti_pact > 2.99 }
					country_exists = YEI
				}
				YEI = { country_event = { id = zin_cold.50 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_cold_giant_pact > 2.99 }
					country_exists = NIV
				}
				NIV = { country_event = { id = zin_cold.50 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# zin_cold.1 on Coldor (section "The situation on 1 Thaw 4A 1748").
zin_cold_startup = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter = 0 }
	MLK = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_isengard_defiance = 70 }
		capital_scope = { set_variable = { global.zin_cold_isengard_seat = THIS } }
	}
	CLD = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_accord_reach = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_yeti_pact = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_giant_pact = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_timber_sales = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_reach_pp = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_cold_reach_winter = 0 }
		add_ideas = zin_coldor_ports_against_interior
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cold_reach_mod }
	}
	HOR = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 60 } }
	FEA = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 0 } }
	AUT = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 } }
	WRL = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	PLT = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	HLD = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 10 } }
	GLI = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	XIS = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	PRT = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	OMR = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	POT = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	KVI = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	ORW = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	NIV = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 0 } }
	YEI = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 0 } }
	GHH = {
		set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = MLK }
			set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -20 }
		}
	}
	VND = { set_variable = { zin_cold_lean = -5 } }
	CLD = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = MLK modifier = zin_opinion_cold_rivalry } }
	MLK = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = CLD modifier = zin_opinion_cold_rivalry } }
	CLD = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = HOR modifier = zin_cold_accord_kin } }
	HOR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = CLD modifier = zin_cold_accord_kin } }
	every_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_region_far_northwest = yes }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cold_far_ice }
	}
	CLD = { zin_cold_update_reach = yes }
	zin_cold_schedule_seasons = yes
}
